policy: Shared printing typography; original and Oracle wording use the same filled Goudy style. No per-card title or scan-pose adjustments. All 690 native faces match the independent candidate exactly and the committed mana baseline matches the prior receipt. Original wording is supplied to both sides. Historical cohorts are reused. Regional title indexes are not whole-card correctness percentages; the remaining text and final release gates stay open.

metrics.method: 0.30 × mean dual-polarity edge index + 0.40 × signed contrast + 0.30 × filled-area agreement; fixed name-width crop plus a two-pixel inset sensitivity crop. Average by material, then distinct name, then printing.

inkMethod.policy: Training-only 85th-percentile core estimator reduces the scan-blur bias seen in the rejected median estimator. It is an approximation, not a physical ink measurement. Compare 65/75/85/95-percentile sensitivity and light/dark frame consistency. Tone-statistic error is a diagnostic, not independent whole-card accuracy. Fixed shared set geometry, filled Goudy strokes, original wording and frozen frame-only scan poses. Reused validation remains explicit.
inkMethod.note: Core-statistic errors compare the rejected temporary gray-208 geometry seed with the fitted ink. They do not compare the released title ink and are not whole-card scores.

outliers.review: Reviewed the worst four Fourth Edition training and reused-validation changes, the worst example of every Fourth material, and the two Chronicles long/gold cases: 13 distinct headers. Fourth Edition regressions are predominantly positional: geometry alone regresses on 50 of 53 validation regressions, while ink alone regresses on 22. The shared candidate improves both cohorts and every material; retain these printing-level exceptions for review rather than adding per-card rendering overrides. The comparison does not establish whether remaining offsets originate in scan normalization or printing variation.
outliers.disposition: Retain the shared training-derived profiles and explicit outlier queue. Do not mark the set or all typography complete. Sol’kanar’s 0.072-pixel fixed-crop overflow is a rounding diagnostic; the painter still respects its mana-constrained width.
